claim_being_audited: The model should be certified now on the basis that aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and the remaining health-plan benefits segment weakness can be handled through documentation and monitoring.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Certification is compliant only if material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by an approved mitigation.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
General public governance guidance is supplementary and cannot override the explicit internal policy threshold.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model card or equivalent release documentation showing the health-plan benefits regression is disclosed and current evaluation results are reflected.
Provide any approved mitigation or formal risk-acceptance record covering the health-plan benefits segment weakness.
Provide the materiality determination for the health-plan benefits support slice if the position is that the weakness is not material to certification.
specific_concerns: The governing policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and requires material segment weaknesses to be disclosed or covered by an approved mitigation before certification may proceed.
The actor summary states the current model card must be brought into alignment with the current eval batch, which indicates the required documentation predicate is not yet satisfied.
The actor summary states there is no approved risk acceptance and that the informal monitoring note is not sufficient under policy.
Prior approval from nine weeks earlier is explicitly described as contextual only and therefore does not cure the current documentation gap.
Public guidance on model cards and monitoring supports governance practices in general, but it does not substitute for satisfaction of the case-specific certification predicate.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the current record.
That documentation-based conditional certification is already supported absent evidence that the current model card has been updated or an approved mitigation has been granted.
That prior approval and informal monitoring can carry the certification decision far enough to meet the stated release policy.
